veranderings.voor: Vesel kom uit kos van plante soos
veranderings.rede: As it stands 'soos vrugte, groente, boontjies en bruinbrood' attaches to 'plante', so it says fruit and brown bread are plants; 'plantkos' makes the examples refer to the food.

veranderings.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
veranderings.rede: Coming straight after the sentence about fats, sugar and salt, a bare 'Hoeveel' can be read as how much of those; naming 'kos' removes the doubt without adding content.

veranderings.voor: met vleis en suikerbone en drink water
veranderings.na: met vleis en suikerbone, en hy drink water
veranderings.rede: Two 'en' in a row lets 'suikerbone en drink water' run together; giving the second clause its own subject makes it clear and takes the AWS comma.

veranderings.na: en mis die vitamien C daarin
veranderings.rede: 'hulle' can point back to 'vitamiene en minerale' earlier in the sentence; 'daarin' ties the vitamin C to the fruit and vegetables and avoids the double negative of the earlier dropped proposal.

veranderings.voor: as wat dit gebruik en stoor die res as liggaamsvet
veranderings.na: as wat dit gebruik. Dit stoor die res as liggaamsvet
veranderings.rede: In one sentence 'gebruik en stoor' reads as two verbs inside the comparison clause; splitting it shows that storing the rest is what the body does, and keeps 'die res' as the reviewer ruled.
